---
name: Reproducibility report
about: Report an unexpected result or workflow behaviour using safe, shareable inputs.
title: "[reproducibility] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## What did you run?

Provide the command, the package version or commit hash, and the operating system/Python version.

## Expected and observed behaviour

Describe what you expected, what occurred instead, and the full error message if available.

## Minimal reproducible example

Include the smallest synthetic or openly shareable CSV example that reproduces the problem. Do not attach patient-identifying information, restricted summary statistics, credentials, or institutional data.

## Research assumptions

State any relevant workflow assumptions or QC thresholds (for example, whether MR instruments were already harmonised and independent).

## Checklist

- [ ] I used only synthetic or openly shareable data.
- [ ] I removed credentials, identifiers, and restricted information.
- [ ] I checked the README and existing issues before filing this report.
